evidence_quotes: Bij besluit van 19 april 2016 heeft de raad het bestemmingsplan "Uitkijktoren Wellerlooi" vastgesteld.
rationale: The Dutch Council of State (RvS) decision concerns a municipal zoning plan (bestemmingsplan) for an observation tower ("Uitkijktoren Wellerlooi"). This is a general spatial planning/zoning matter with no substantive water law, water infrastructure, flood defence, or water service access dimension.
